svg.title: Two measurement faults and the safe state
svg.desc: When the reading jumps to 85 degrees Celsius at 5 seconds, the heater gets 0 percent in the same scan. When the sensor freezes at 5 seconds, the fault is latched at 5.5 seconds, when its last reading is 0.5 seconds old. After the acknowledgement and the Auto request at 7 seconds, the controller restarts from 0 percent; the water cools to 27.36 and 27.87 degrees and is back within 0.2 degrees after about 29 seconds.
svg.text: Two measurement faults and the safe state
Control Studio validation trials · Kp 6.95, Ki 1.37, β 0.8, Tf 1 s · fault at 5 s, acknowledged at 6 s, Auto requested at 7 s · numbers answer the predictions
Invalid reading: 0 % in the same scan, at 5.0 s
Frozen sensor: fault at 5.5 s, when its reading is 0.5 s old
Restart from 0 %: lowest 27.36 °C, within ±0.2 °C after 29.4 s
